stories.title: Driver charged in connection with Lehi auto-pedestrian crash
stories.summary: A woman who police say ran a red light and hit another woman in a crosswalk has been charged.

stories.title: Have You Seen This? Professional cliff jumper climbs, dives off iceberg
stories.summary: Red Bull athlete and professional cliff jumper Molly Carlson became the first woman to dive off an iceberg, jumping nearly 50 feet.

stories.title: Church of Jesus Christ celebrates 10 years of Light the World Giving Machines with new locations
stories.summary: There are 145 locations with Giving Machines this season as part of the 'Light the World' seasonal initiative run by The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. People can donate to others helping local and international causes at the vending machines.

stories.title: 'Broken Cowboy': New documentary highlights paralyzed artist who turns scrap metal into art
stories.summary: Decades after a 1979 accident left former rodeo hopeful Matt Clark paralyzed, the Diamond Valley artist has built a second life, turning discarded scrap metal into intricate sculptures.

stories.title: 3 stresses to get organized now so December can be for celebrating
stories.summary: KSL lifestyle contributor Jenny Layton shared three things to organize before the holiday pace picks up.

stories.title: Classified communications network at National Security Agency goes down, defense official says
stories.summary: An internal network the National Security Agency uses to communicate classified information has gone offline after what one U.S. official described as "routine maintenance."

stories.title: Glasses, shirt buttons will be examined to stop cheating in South Korea's college entrance exams
stories.summary: Proctors will inspect glasses and seal shirt buttons with stickers, and authorities will deploy 8,400 additional supervisors at South Korea's college entrance exams on Thursday.

stories.title: Man with history of making terroristic threats accused of threatening judge, police
stories.summary: A man previously convicted of threatening 911 dispatchers and West Valley businesses is now accused of threatening West Valley police and a judge.

stories.title: Ex-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang signals interest in returning to the company following scandal
stories.summary: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is signaling his interest in returning to lead the computer chip company.

stories.title: FAA temporarily stops router installations connected to air travel stoppage
stories.summary: The Federal Aviation Administration has paused installing routers linked to last week's air traffic trouble that caused chaos for travelers.

stories.title: He plans to run 11,350 miles around the country. He's taking his family and God with him
stories.summary: Chris Avery started running on Jan. 9, 2022. Now he's planning to run a 50K, or 31.1 miles, every day, for charity, starting on Jan. 1, 2027. Not bad for a man who doesn't like running.

stories.title: A 2-month lull ends with Iran's third strike on US targets in Bahrain
stories.summary: Iran has fired drones at a U.S. radar facility in Bahrain on Tuesday, Iran's third attack on American military targets in the kingdom in recent days.
